arms.C1-PR: immutable historical C1 scores,35-parameter checkpoints and thresholds
arms.C1-ABS: new historical Head(C1),patient-equal FIT global standardization
arms.C1-SHUFFLE: new historical Head(C1),historical PR transform then fixed within-patient derangement

new_training.order: historical seeded(patient-order,epoch) permutation of sorted training IDs

inner_split: exact historical head_data.plan and private ASSIGNMENT_PRIVATE.pt parity; three real-source-stratified patient partitions
ABS_scaler: two-pass float64 patient-equal mean and total variance including between-patient variation; all good channels; inner-training only or full outer-FIT refit only; epsilon1e-5; transform cast float32
shuffle: SHA256(seed42,outerfold,FIT-or-HELD,pseudonymous_patient_key,embedding-derangement); fixed rejection-sampled uniform derangement,max1024 labelblind attempts; no label/logit/source permutation; all good channels including unknown
epoch_selection: complete inner head-OOF mean patient AUROC,AP,earlier epoch
threshold: historical201point0:.005:1 grid,patient MacroF1,pathological F1,balanced accuracy,closest0.5,smaller; historical C0/PR unchanged; new thresholds inner head-OOF only
freeze: all ten new models,scalers,permutation manifest and thresholds hash-frozen before any new outer score; historical ten selections remain unchanged
primary_metrics: historical patient-equal metrics from sigmoid(mean frozen logit + float32 learned correction); canonical stable ties; no pooled substitution
interventions: frozen original C1-PR,no retraining,no threshold fitting; SCALE_ONLY and same prelocked within-patient shuffle used by trained SHUFFLE
scale_identity: direct float64 formula with original float32 patient moments; verify original operational PR replay,logit constant-shift identity and pairwise ordering; logit ranking if sigmoid saturation ties; classification uses direct formula at original threshold
terminal_priority: ABS higher AUROC with PR-ABS CI upper<0 and ABS AP>=PR AP=>ABSOLUTE_EMBEDDING_BETTER
PR-ABS entire AUROC CI within[-.010,.010],ABS-C0 AUROC CI low>0,ABS AP/MacroF1 nondecline vsC0,and aligned PR/ABS both>=shuffle+.010=>LINEAR_RECALIBRATION_SUFFICIENT
interpretation: CI containment is a prespecified descriptive comparability rule,not an unregistered equivalence test; no terminal chosen from best point estimate alone; centering/scaling/optimization/learned-beta interactions not causally separated
